history.message:
chore: add SYNTHETIC example results for leaderboard development
NOT REAL BENCHMARK RESULTS. Every score in these files was randomly
generated (seed 2026) to exercise the leaderboard page; it says nothing
about the named models. Each file carries `metadata.synthetic`.
The files mirror `wp-bench run` output (test definitions, scoring and
aggregation go through the harness code; only per-model performance is
sampled) and cover the cases a leaderboard must handle:
- results_20261020_093000: wp-core-v1, 7 models (multi-model payload)
- results_20261022_141500: one local model, 100 tests, null cost,
  5 errored tests (single-model payload)
- results_20261024_110000: skills A/B, 2 models x baseline/+skills, 60 tests
- results_20261026_160000: wp-cli-v1, 3 models
- results_20261028_083000: one model, 10 tests (single-model payload)
